sanskrit: bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ mābhi yātaṃ bhūtapatī paśupatī namo vām | pratihitam āyatāṃ mā vi srāṣṭaṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ dvipado mā catuṣpadaḥ ||
english: O Bhava and Śarva, show us grace; come not against us — you, Lords of Beings, Lords of Cattle, homage to you both. What has been aimed, let it turn back; release it not upon us; harm not our two-footed ones nor our four-footed ones.

sanskrit: śune kroṣṭre mā śarīrāṇi kartam aliklavebhyo gṛdhrebhyo ye ca kṛṣṇā aviṣyavaḥ | makṣikāḥ paśupate vayāṃsi te vighase mā vidanta ||
english: Do not make our bodies a portion for the howling jackal, for the vultures, nor for those dark carrion-birds that are unfeathered. O Paśupati, the flies, the birds — let them be thine for the feast; let them not find us as their prey.

sanskrit: krandāya te prāṇāya te yāś ca te bhava ropayaḥ | namas te rudra kṛṇmaḥ sahasrākṣāmartya ||
english: To thy cry, to thy breath, and to thy festering wounds, O Bhava — homage we render to thee, O Rudra, O thousand-eyed Immortal.

sanskrit: purastāt te namaḥ kṛṇma uttarād adharād uta | abhīvargād divas pary antarikṣāya te namaḥ ||
english: From the east we make homage to thee, from the north, from below as well; from the surrounding quarters, from across the sky — to thee, O Antarikṣa, homage.

sanskrit: mukhāya te paśupate yāni cakṣūṃṣi te bhava | tvace rūpāya saṃdṛśe pratīcīnāya te namaḥ ||
english: To thy face, O Paśupati; to thy eyes, O Bhava; to thy skin, to thy form, to thine aspect, to thy western-turned presence — homage to thee.

sanskrit: aṅgebhya udarāya jihvāyā āsyāya ca | dadbhyo gandhāya te namaḥ ||
english: To thy limbs, to thy belly, to thy tongue and to thy mouth, to thy teeth, to thy scent — homage to thee.

sanskrit: astrā nīlaśikhaṇḍena sahasrākṣeṇa vājinā | rudreṇādhvagaghātinā tena mā sam arāmahi ||
english: With Rudra of the blue crest-plume, the thousand-eyed, the vigorous, the slayer of wayfarers — with that one let us not come into collision.

sanskrit: sa no bhavaḥ pari vṛṇaktu viśvata āpa ivāgniḥ pari vṛṇaktu no bhavaḥ | mā no abhi maṃsta namo astv asmai ||
english: May Bhava encompass us on all sides; as fire encompasses water, so may Bhava encompass us. Let him not take aim at us — homage be to him.

sanskrit: catur namo aṣṭakṛtvo bhavāya daśa kṛtvaḥ paśupate namas te | taveme pañca paśavo vibhaktā gāvo aśvāḥ puruṣā ād ajāvayaḥ ||
english: Four times homage, eight times homage to Bhava; ten times, O Paśupati, homage to thee. Thine are these five categories of cattle apportioned: kine, horses, men, and then goats and sheep.

sanskrit: tava catasraḥ pradiśas tava dyaus tavedam ugrorv antarikṣam | tavedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad yad ejad adhi bhūmyām ||
english: Thine are the four cardinal directions; thine is the sky; thine, O Fierce One, is this vast mid-air. Thine is all this that possesses breath, all that stirs upon the earth.

sanskrit: uruḥ kośo vasudhānas tavāyaṃ yasminn imā viśvā bhūtāny antaḥ | sa no mṛḍa paśupate namas te paraḥ kroṣṭāro abhibhāḥ śvānaḥ | paro yantv agharudo vikeśyaḥ ||
english: Wide is this treasury that bears wealth — thine it is — within which all these beings are contained. He, O Paśupati — show us grace, homage to thee. Let the howling jackals and the menacing dogs go far away; let the ill-voiced, dishevelled ones depart afar.

sanskrit: dhanur bibharṣi haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasraghni śatavadhaṃ śikhaṇḍin | rudrasyeṣuś carati devahetis tasmai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||
english: Thou bearest the tawny golden bow, O Crested One, slayer of thousands, smiter of hundreds. Rudra's arrow courses forth — the divine missile; to that one homage, in whichever direction it travels.

sanskrit: yo 'bhiyāto nilayate tvām ugra nicikīrṣati | paścād anuprayuṅkṣe taṃ viddhasya padanīr iva ||
english: He who comes against thee, O Fierce One, who lies in wait desiring to injure thee — thou dost dispatch thine arrow after him from behind, as one tracking the footprints of the wounded.

sanskrit: bhavārudrau sayujā saṃvidānāv ubhā ugrau carato vīryāya | tayor bhūmir antarikṣaṃ svar dyaus tābhyāṃ namo bhavamatyāya kṛṇmaḥ ||
english: Bhava and Rudra, yoked together and in accord, both fierce, move forth for the exercise of might. Between them are the earth, the mid-air, the sun, the sky — to those two we render homage with all that belongs to Bhava.

sanskrit: namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate | namas te rudra tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ ||
english: Homage to thee as thou comest; homage to thee as thou departest. Homage to thee, O Rudra, as thou standest still; and homage to thee as thou art seated.

sanskrit: namaḥ sāyaṃ namaḥ prātar namo rātryā namo divā | bhavāya ca śarvāya ca- -ubhābhyām akaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: Homage at evening, homage at dawn, homage by night, homage by day — to Bhava and to Śarva, to both of them together I have rendered homage.

sanskrit: sahasrākṣam atipaśyaṃ purastād rudram asyantaṃ bahudhā vipaścitam | mopārāma jihvayeyamānam ||
english: I behold in front the thousand-eyed Rudra, shooting his shafts in many ways, the all-knowing. May I not cease from praising him who makes himself known through speech.

sanskrit: śyāvāsvāṃ kṛṣṇam asitaṃ mṛṇantaṃ bhīmaṃ rathaṃ keśinaḥ pādayantam | pūrve pratīmo namo astv asmai ||
english: Him of dark bay horses, the black, the very dark, who crushes down, terrible, driving his dread chariot, the long-haired one — we meet him from the front; homage be to him.

sanskrit: mā no 'bhi srā matyaṃ devahetiṃ mā naḥ krudhaḥ paśupate namas te | anyatrāsmad divyāṃ śākhāṃ vi dhūnu ||
english: Cast not down upon us the mortal divine missile; be not wrathful against us, O Paśupati — homage to thee. Elsewhere than toward us shake thy heavenly branch.

sanskrit: mā no hiṃsīr adhi brūhi pari ṇo vṛṅdhi mā krudha | mā tvayā sam arāmahi ||
english: Harm us not; speak favorably over us; wrap us in thy protection; be not angry. Let us not come to collision with thee.

sanskrit: mā no aśveṣu goṣu puruṣeṣu mā gṛdho no ajāviṣu | anyatrogra vi vartaya piyārūṇāṃ prajāṃ jahi ||
english: Covet not our horses, our kine, our men; covet not our goats and sheep, O Fierce One. Turn away elsewhere; slay the offspring of the revilers.

sanskrit: yasya takmā kāsikā hetir ekā- -aśvasyeva vṛṣaṇaḥ kranda eti | abhipūrvaṃ nirṇayate namo astv asmai ||
english: Whose weapon is the fever, the cough — his one missile — which goes roaring like the snorting of a stallion; he drives it out, from the front, successively — homage be to him.

sanskrit: yas tiṣṭhati viṣṭabhito antarikṣe 'yajvanaḥ pramṛṇan devapīyūn | tasmai namo daśabhiḥ śakvarībhiḥ ||
english: He who stands firmly established in the mid-air, crushing down the non-sacrificers, the scorners of the gods — to him homage with ten Śakvarī verses.

sanskrit: tubhyam āraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitās tubhyaṃ vayāṃsi śakunāḥ patatriṇaḥ | tava yakṣmaṃ paśupate apsv antas tubhyaṃ kṣaranti divyā āpo vṛdhe ||
english: To thee belong the forest animals, the wild beasts set in the woodland; to thee belong the birds and winged fowl. Thine, O Paśupati, is the wasting-disease hidden in the waters; to thee the heavenly waters flow for thy increase.

sanskrit: śiṃśumārā ajagarāḥ pulīkayā jaṣā matsyā rajasā yebhyo asyasi | na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭha- -asti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvāṃ pari paśyasi bhūmim ||
english: The Śiṃśumāras, the pythons, the Pulīkas, the crocodiles and fishes — upon all these thou dost shoot in the mist. Nothing is far from thee, nothing beyond thy reach, O Bhava; thou beholdest all the earth at once.

sanskrit: pūrvasmād dhaṃsy uttarasmin samudre mā no rudra takmanā na viṣeṇa | mā naḥ saṃ srā divyenāgninā- -anyatrāsmad vidyutāṃ pātayaitām ||
english: Thou strikest from the eastern ocean into the northern sea. Harm us not, O Rudra, with fever nor with poison; pour not down upon us the heavenly fire — let lightning strike elsewhere than upon us.

sanskrit: bhavo divo bhava īśe pṛthivyā bhava ā papra urv antarikṣam | tasya na prāpad ducchunā kā caneha ||
english: Bhava is lord of the sky; Bhava is lord of the earth; Bhava has filled the vast mid-air. Let no ill-omen whatsoever reach here to harm him.

sanskrit: bhava rājan yajamānāya mṛḍa paśūnāṃ hi paśupatir babhūtha | yaḥ śraddadhāti santi devā iti catuṣpade dvipade asya mṛḍa ||
english: O King Bhava, show grace to the sacrificer — for thou hast become the Lord of Cattle among cattle. He who has faith that the gods exist — show grace upon his four-footed and his two-footed ones.

sanskrit: mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakaṃ mā naḥ kṣiyantaṃ uta mā no akṣitaḥ | mā no hiṃsīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ svāṃ tanvaṃ rudra mā rīriṣo naḥ ||
english: Harm not our great one, nor our little one; harm not our waning one, nor our unwasted one. Injure not our father, nor our mother; O Rudra, wound not thine own body — harm us not.

sanskrit: rudrasyailabakārebhyo 'saṃsūktagirebhyaḥ | idaṃ mahāsyebhyaḥ śvabhyo akaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: To the dogs of Rudra that utter the sound ailabaka, whose voice is not well-spoken, to these wide-mouthed ones I have rendered homage.

sanskrit: namas te ghoṣiṇībhyo namas te keśinībhyaḥ | namaḥ saṃyatībhyo namo namasvatībhyaḥ ||
english: Homage to you, the clamorous ones; homage to you, the long-haired ones. Homage to you, the restrained ones; homage to you, the ones full of reverence.
